title: Infernal Metal
summary: Infernal material carried by Yurgir. The Infernal Iron source lists this item as the Gauntlet of Shar form of that resource.

fields.Crafting: The Infernal Iron source identifies this as Yurgir’s variant. Bring infernal material to Dammon for Karlach’s engine upgrades or the Flawed Helldusk armour, helmet and gloves.
fields.Base value: 100 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
